clue.text: Republicans question war-torn nation

parts.note: the IRA, the Irish Republican Army, stands for republicans

explanation.surface: Republican campaigners challenge the case for fighting in a country torn by war.
explanation.definitionFit: Iraq is a Middle Eastern country that suffered years of conflict, so it fits a war-torn nation.

clue.text: How much, when wise man arrives at function?

indicators.note: one piece arriving at another is placed straight after it

parts.note: a do is a party or social function
a sage is a wise man

explanation.surface: Someone asks what the quantity is when a guru turns up at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A dosage is the measured amount of a medicine to be taken, answering a question about quantity.

clue.text: History teacher? Very proficient one!

definitions.meaning: playfully, a master (teacher) of the past, that is of history
an expert who has thoroughly mastered a skill

explanation.definitionFit: A past master is an acknowledged expert, and read literally it suggests a schoolmaster of bygone times.

clue.text: Father of Horus or Isis, somehow!

indicators.note: somehow means the letters are rearranged in some unspecified way

explanation.surface: The paternity of the falcon god is credited to one of two deities, depending on the account.
explanation.walkthrough: Isis was in fact the mother of Horus, which makes the surface plausible; the anagram signal rearranges ORISIS.
explanation.definitionFit: In Egyptian myth Osiris and Isis were the parents of the falcon-headed god Horus.

clue.text: Hideous crones finally became even watchable

indicators.note: hideous suggests something misshapen, so the letters are distorted into a new order
finally takes the closing letter of each of the two following words

explanation.surface: Ugly old women eventually turned out to be pleasant to look at.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' gives E and N, the last letters of 'became' and 'even', to join CRONES before 'Hideous' rearranges all eight letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on-screen is shown on television or film, so it is there to be watched.

clue.text: Hold out a model of repair

definitions.meaning: to endure or survive for a time
a cobbler's foot-shaped block used when mending shoes

explanation.definitionFit: To last is to hold out, and a last is the shoemaker's foot-shaped form used for repairs.

clue.text: Just a little resistance in dissenting group

indicators.note: in places the resistance letter inside the group word

parts.note: a faction is a breakaway group within a party
R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A small amount of opposition exists within a breakaway party.
explanation.definitionFit: A fraction is a small part or tiny amount, as in a fraction of the cost.

clue.text: Protection for us from Australia — a hen!

parts.note: Oz is a familiar name for Australia
a means one
a laying hen is called a layer

explanation.surface: An Australian hen is offered as our protector, absurdly.
explanation.definitionFit: The ozone layer in the upper atmosphere shields people on Earth from harmful ultraviolet light.

clue.text: Brazilian city judge grabs a wine

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, known as Rio, is a Brazilian city

explanation.surface: A judge in Rio picks up a bottle of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Rioja is a red or white Spanish wine from the region of that name.

clue.text: December visitor on sailing holiday's reported location on Tenerife

parts.note: Santa Claus visits at Christmas, in December

indicators.note: reported means the word is spoken, giving a word that sounds like it

parts.note: a cruise is a holiday at sea

explanation.surface: Father Christmas takes a cruise and is said to be in the Canary Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: Santa Cruz de Tenerife is the capital city of the island of Tenerife.

clue.text: District 7

definitions.meaning: an area or neighbourhood of a town
points to the answer at 7 Down, and a ... is one such portion of a whole

explanation.definitionFit: A quarter is both a part of a town and one fourth, a portion of a whole number.

clue.text: 3-D image of musical to prerecord

parts.note: Cats is a famous stage musical
to can a programme is to record it in advance, put it in the can

explanation.surface: Someone wants a picture of a stage show recorded before broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: A CAT scan uses computed tomography to build a cross-sectional, three-dimensional picture of the body.

clue.text: It's the last of the home games

indicators.note: of the means the letters are taken from within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A fixture is described as the final one played at the home ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Omega is the final letter of the Greek alphabet, hence a byword for the end.

clue.text: Franco-German agreement underwritten by directors giving medium assistance

indicators.note: in a down entry, written underneath means the second piece comes below the first

parts.note: oui and ja mean yes in French and German
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: A treaty between France and Germany is guaranteed by company directors.
explanation.definitionFit: A Ouija board is used at seances, supposedly helping a spiritualist medium contact the dead.

clue.text: Rapidly realise one's calling

parts.note: reads as discovering a vocation fast, but means making a phone call quickly with a stored shortcut

explanation.definitionFit: Speed dial stores a number so a phone call can be placed with a single press.

clue.text: Result of operation — contention

definitions.meaning: the outcome of a subtraction sum in arithmetic
a dispute or disagreement between parties

explanation.definitionFit: A difference is what remains after subtracting, and also a quarrel, as in settling differences.

clue.text: No gunmen fit in by going berserk, seriously

indicators.note: going berserk means running wild, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Armed men are not allowed to blend in by running amok, and that is no joke.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a colloquial way of saying one is speaking seriously and not joking.

clue.text: US senior suffering breakdown

indicators.note: suffering suggests being damaged, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: An elderly American is having a nervous collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: A neurosis is a mental disorder, loosely a nervous breakdown.

clue.text: The vegetable urge works!

parts.note: to egg on is to urge
a plant is a factory or works

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims that pushing a vegetable along actually succeeds.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggplant is the American name for the aubergine, a vegetable.

clue.text: Both sides leave a quarrel with soldier, a catalyst of Golden Dissolution?

indicators.note: both sides are right and left, and leave says their letters depart from the phrase

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: Two sides walk out of a row with a soldier over an agent that triggers a golden breakup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Both sides' are the abbreviations for right and left, R and L, not the outer letters; removing them from AQUARREL leaves AQUARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Aqua regia, a mix of nitric and hydrochloric acids, is famous for dissolving gold.

clue.text: A dry haven needed by former PM

parts.note: TT means teetotal, abstaining from alcohol
a lee is a sheltered side or refuge

explanation.surface: A former prime minister needed a refuge where no drink was served.
explanation.definitionFit: Clement Attlee was British Prime Minister from 1945 to 1951.

clue.text: In English school fundamentals, not one mistake

indicators.note: In puts the nothing letter inside the three Rs

parts.note: the three Rs, reading, writing and arithmetic
not one is nothing, which is O

explanation.surface: Someone notes that in basic English schooling not a single mistake was made.
explanation.definitionFit: Error is a plain synonym for a mistake, an act or judgement that is wrong.

clue.text: Water that separated seed sown in sun

indicators.note: in puts the scattered letters inside the sun god

parts.note: Ra is the Egyptian sun god

indicators.note: sown means scattered, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Seed is scattered on sunlit ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sown' hides its anagram role behind the farming picture; Ra, the Egyptian sun god, is the 'sun' here.
explanation.definitionFit: The Red Sea is the water that, in Exodus, parted so the Israelites could cross.

clue.text: Duck I'd bagged in appropriate location's eggy

indicators.note: bagged in means held inside another piece

parts.note: the Oval cricket ground is a fitting place for a duck, a score of nothing
a duck is a score of nought, O
taken as written

explanation.surface: A duck I caught in the right spot is full of eggs.
explanation.walkthrough: THE OVAL is a London cricket ground, an apt place for a duck (no runs).
explanation.definitionFit: Ovoidal means egg-shaped, so eggy in shape.

clue.text: Skirting round mate of Mother Superior?

indicators.note: in a down entry, superior means placed above the next piece

parts.note: Mother's partner is Dad
a round letter is O

explanation.surface: Someone avoids the companion of the head of a convent.
explanation.definitionFit: A dado is the lower part of an interior wall, akin to skirting.

clue.text: Time divers used to dip into northern river

indicators.note: to dip into means to go inside the river

parts.note: the Tay is a river in Scotland

indicators.note: divers means varied, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Divers once dived into a river in the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'divers' is an old word for 'various', not swimmers; it turns USED into UESD.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuesday is a day of the week, a period of time.

clue.text: City offering choice of ends of Holy Week

indicators.note: of here sets the choice word among the letters
ends of means the closing letter of each word

parts.note: or offers a choice between alternatives

explanation.surface: A cathedral city offers a range of services at the close of Easter week.
explanation.definitionFit: York is a historic English cathedral city.

clue.text: Steps taken to attract cats and dogs?

definitions.text: Steps taken to attract cats and dogs?

parts.words: Steps taken to attract cats and dogs?
parts.note: steps are dance moves, and it is raining cats and dogs means heavy rain

explanation.definitionFit: A rain dance is a ritual dance performed to bring rainfall.

clue.text: Empty net

definitions.meaning: to empty or remove everything from
remaining after deductions, as in net profit

explanation.definitionFit: To clear is to empty, and a clear profit is the net amount after costs.
